channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brandon Jennings | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brandon Jennings from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
“Brandon Jennings can have his ideas and opinions, but to act like it came from me is the wildest part. I don't talk to this guy. He's got his own opinions on the league, which is fine. But the response to that was like I was saying it. Like, why are [people] even spending this much time worrying about ... Does KD deserve better? Or he doesn't deserve better? Like, why are you even talking about this?”

Kevin Durant on Brandon Jennings, Jan 10, 2024. Source: FoxSports.com.

item.title: Larry Sanders on Brandon Jennings, Keyon Dooling, Drew Gooden, Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“I played with Brandon Jennings, Monte Ellis, Drew Gooden, Keyon Dooling, Andrew Bogut and I had great teammates,”

Larry Sanders on Brandon Jennings, Keyon Dooling, Drew Gooden, Andrew Bogut, Jun 1, 2020. Source: CBS Chicago.

item.title: Javale McGee on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
Chris Haynes:JaVale McGee on Jennings' comment:

“I'm glad Brandon fouled me. I was going to air ball that three. Shout out to Brandon Jennings.”

Javale McGee on Brandon Jennings, Apr 3, 2017. Source: Twitter @ChrisBHaynes.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
“Brandon gives us playmaking ability and experience at the guard position while adding another scoring option as well,”

Ernie Grunfeld on Brandon Jennings, Mar 1, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
“I still don’t know if it was more Brandon or the organization or a mutual agreement.”

Carmelo Anthony on Brandon Jennings, Feb 28, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Brandon Jennings, Ron Baker
item.description:
Ian Begley:Hornacek:

“(Just) because Brandon was waived doesn’t mean that we’re not trying to win these games. We feel Ron Baker can fill right in.”

Jeff Hornacek on Brandon Jennings, Ron Baker, Feb 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Rob Hennigan on Brandon Jennings, Ersan Ilyasova
item.description:
The Orlando Magic have acquired guard Brandon Jennings and forward Ersan Ilyasova from the Detroit Pistons in exchange for forward Tobias Harris, General Manager Rob Hennigan announced today.

“Brandon (Jennings) and Ersan (Ilyasova) are two veterans that will help balance our roster and provide valuable experience to our team,”

Rob Hennigan on Brandon Jennings, Ersan Ilyasova, Feb 16, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
But Stan Van Gundy sees room for both – certainly for the remainder of this season, as Jennings ramps up to a more substantial role, and even beyond.

“Our plan right now is that Brandon can help us make a playoff push,”

Stan Van Gundy on Brandon Jennings, Jan 5, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
“I just think that people assume that with Reggie (Jackson) here and the way Brandon played last year, I think people just make that assumption. He's no more or less available than anybody else we have.”

Stan Van Gundy on Brandon Jennings, Dec 15, 2015. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
“Reggie is big enough (6-feet-3) to guard guys off the ball and everything else. It just gives you two playmakers on the floor together. I think they can be pretty dynamic, but we'll just have to see where Brandon is when he comes back.”

Stan Van Gundy on Brandon Jennings, Sep 14, 2015. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
Van Gundy told WMGC-FM(105.1).

“We don't know where Brandon's gonna be health-wise. Right now, he's still recovering.”

Stan Van Gundy on Brandon Jennings, Sep 14, 2015. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Reggie Jackson on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Reggie Jackson:

“Anyone who watches the game, Brandon Jennings destroyed Reggie Jackson. Lost the matchup and that's why we lost tonight.”

Reggie Jackson on Brandon Jennings, Nov 15, 2014. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
And Billups makes a point to approach Jennings when he has words of wisdom.

“I really enjoy working with Brandon and trying to teach him to take the reins and taking responsibility for being a leader,”

Chauncey Billups on Brandon Jennings, Feb 12, 2014. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Dumars on his previous denials on Jennings:

“We started talking last Friday. John asked 'do you have any interest in BJ' I said,”

Joe Dumars on Brandon Jennings, Aug 6, 2013. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Jim Boylan on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
“I talk to a lot of people around the league, a lot of people around Brandon. I don't get that feeling from him; I don't get that feeling from his people.”

Jim Boylan on Brandon Jennings, Feb 17, 2013. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: John Hammond on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
In talking with Bucks.com, Hammond said that is not the plan.

“We like our team, we really like Brandon and Monta. We like them playing together, we think they are a dynamic backcourt. And our hope is we can keep that back court together.”

John Hammond on Brandon Jennings, Jan 25, 2013. Source: NBCSports.com.

item.title: Scott Skiles on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
Evans Clinchy:Skiles on Monta/Jennings:

“They get along, they pass the ball to each other, they move it to their teammates. I don't see any issues.”

Scott Skiles on Brandon Jennings, Nov 2, 2012. Source: Twitter @evansclinchy.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Brandon Jennings
item.description:
Like a surprising number of things now do, the idea for Impact Basketball Competitive Training Series—a two-week long semi-league taking place at trainer Joe Abunassar’s Las Vegas, NV, Impact Basketball facility—was polished if not born on Twitter.

“I was talking to Brandon Jennings on Twitter and told him that we were going to do something,”

Jared Dudley on Brandon Jennings, Sep 7, 2011. Source: SLAM.
